name: 92704 · Santa Ana, CA
findings: ZIP 92704 (Santa Ana) has 136 nonprofit organizations. 36 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92704 (Santa Ana) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 92704 (Santa Ana) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 67% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 40 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
